newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany urges its citizens to leave Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Germany urges its citizens to leave Zaire.

text.p: The German Foreign Ministry on Wednesday advised all German nationals in Zaire to leave in the face of advances by rebels over large swathes of the Central African country.

A ministry spokesman said around 200 Germans remained in Zaire, most of them in the capital Kinshasa. Germans had previously been advised to leave northern and eastern parts of the country which were already regarded as too dangerous.
The Alliance of Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Congo-Zaire has seized a fifth of Zaire since launching its rebellion in October to overthrow President Mobutu Sese Seko.
The rebels have so far rejected international pressure for a ceasefire, vowing to conduct a speedy war to remove the ailing leader.
